purpose: Execute the atomic mirror-body-or-feature operation within the MA-17 boundary: One non-associative root-body mirror across a supplied planar face. Relationships and merging are disabled; feature, component, occurrence, and source-consuming variants are outside this atom.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires mirror-body-or-feature and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: The current closed positive-volume body to mirror.

inputs.name: plane_face
inputs.description: A current planar face defining the mirror plane.

inputs.name: source_policy
inputs.description: The current non-associative variant preserves the source body.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance for source and mirrored-body volume comparison.

inputs.name: bbox_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance for confirming that the preserved source bounds do not change.

preconditions: body is a current closed positive-volume root DesignBody.
plane_face is a current planar face in the root design.
source_policy is exactly preserve and both tolerances are finite and nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A newly detected current root mirrored body; the supplied source remains unchanged.

postconditions: Mirror.Execute creates exactly one new closed positive-volume root body without associative relationships or merging.
The supplied source remains present with its original volume and bounds within the declared tolerances.
The mirrored body preserves source volume within volume_tolerance_mm3 and passes the closed-solid check.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic mirror-body-or-feature operation within the MA-17 boundary: One non-associative root-body mirror across a supplied planar face. Relationships and merging are disabled; feature, component, occurrence, and source-consuming variants are outside this atom. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Root bodies are enumerated before and after Mirror.Execute; all prior body/face references are stale after the mutation.

failure_modes.condition: Body is stale/noncurrent, plane_face is not current planar topology, source_policy is not preserve, or tolerances are invalid.
failure_modes.detection: Body is stale/noncurrent, plane_face is not current planar topology, source_policy is not preserve, or tolerances are invalid.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: Mirror.Execute reports failure, no unique mirrored body is found, or source volume/bounds change beyond tolerance.
failure_modes.detection: Mirror.Execute reports failure, no unique mirrored body is found, or source volume/bounds change beyond tolerance.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate current root topology, supply a planar mirror face and preserve policy, and rerun from the unchanged source.
Discard or reopen the run-owned document, diagnose plane feasibility, and rerun from a clean source; do not promote the partial result.
